title: Context Descriptor
description: Schema for a Unity CLI context descriptor. All contexts are read-only and output unified envelope responses.

category.description: Logical category: project, editor, scene, prefab, menu, tests, or custom.

source.description: Whether this context is built into the CLI package or contributed by a project extension.

requiresUnity.description: Whether the context requires a live Unity Bridge connection.

available.description: Whether the context is currently available.

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema for context read input parameters.

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema for context read output.

bridgeCommand.description: Bridge command name for reading this context.

cliCommand.description: CLI command for reading this context.

requiresPackages.description: Unity package names required for this context to be available.

extensionId.description: Extension ID if this context comes from an extension.

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint hash of the descriptor for integrity verification.

dependencies.description: Names of other contexts this context depends on.
